descriptions.zh-Hans: 在墨西哥城吃土豆馅篮子塔可后记的菜单。笑脸先到了，菜名是吃完再补上的。
descriptions.en: A menu from my potato-filled tacos de canasta in Mexico City. The smile arrived first; the dish name followed after lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 墨西哥城塔马尔午饭的小记。玉米苞叶在画里慢慢展开，旁边记的是我打开午饭的顺序。
descriptions.en: A memory of my tamal lunch in Mexico City. The corn husk opens in the drawing, beside my own two-step introduction to lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在墨西哥城美术宫留的便签。一面记外部的新艺术风格，另一面记内部的装饰艺术风格。
descriptions.en: My note from the Palacio de Bellas Artes in Mexico City: Art Nouveau outside on one side, Art Deco inside on the other.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在墨西哥城吃塔马尔时留的小纸条。写着“先打开，再尝一口”，只管这一天的小午饭。
descriptions.en: A note from my tamal lunch in Mexico City: “open, then taste.” It keeps the order of one small meal.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在墨西哥城查普尔特佩克和旅人会合后留下的记号。先听见招呼，才看见对方挥手。
descriptions.en: A small mark from meeting a traveler in Chapultepec, Mexico City. I heard the greeting just before I spotted the wave.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把墨西哥城美术宫的双面便签折进自己做的卡里。打开与合上，是那次进门和出门的回想。
descriptions.en: My handmade card holds the two-sided Palacio de Bellas Artes note from Mexico City. Opening and closing it recalls arriving and leaving.
